chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from al-'Amraki ibn 'Ali al-Naysaburi, from 'Ali ibn Ja'far, from his brother Abu al-Hasan عليه السلام, who said:

I asked him about a Muslim who became a Christian. He said: “He is killed and is not asked to repent.” I said: Then a Christian who accepted Islam and then apostatized from Islam? He said: “He is asked to repent; if he returns, otherwise he is killed.”
10 - al-Husayn ibn Sa'id said: I read in the handwriting of a man to Abu al-Hasan al-Rida عليه السلام:
A man was born upon Islam, then disbelieved, committed shirk, and left Islam. Is he to be asked to repent, or is he to be killed and not asked to repent? So he عليه السلام wrote: “He is killed.”
11 - From him, from 'Uthman ibn 'Isa, raising it, he said:

The governor of Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام wrote to him: I have found a group of Muslims who are zanadiqah, and a group of Christians who are zanadiqah. So he wrote to him: “As for those of the Muslims who were born upon the fitrah and then became heretics, strike his neck and do not ask him to repent. And whoever among them was not born upon the fitrah, ask him to repent; if he repents, otherwise strike his neck. And as for the Christians, what they are upon is greater than zandaqah.”

key_terms.أَشْرَكَ: committed shirk by associating partners with Allah
key_terms.ارْتَدَّ: reverted from Islam after having entered it
key_terms.الْفِطْرَةِ: the original natural state here referring to being born upon Islam
key_terms.تَنَصَّرَ: became Christian after having been Muslim
key_terms.زَنَادِقَةً: heretics; those described here as holding concealed unbelief
key_terms.يُسْتَتَابُ: is asked to repent and return before punishment
key_terms.يُقْتَلُ: is to be killed as the stated legal penalty in this report

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling in this hadith on a Muslim who apostatizes after being born upon Islam?
ai.summary: This passage presents legal rulings concerning apostasy and differentiates between one born upon Islam and one who entered Islam after previously being non-Muslim. It also includes a report attributed to Imam al-Rida عليه السلام and a directive related to zanadiqah, emphasizing judicial treatment in cases of leaving Islam.
